notes.title: Dev Update #9: Game state and things to come (Steam Next Fest)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This last weeks I haven't been as active as I would have liked. I was focused on finishing the demo and the core mechanics of the game, and for personal reasons I couldn't be more active on the social media. From now on I expect to continue with my media acounts and the development of The Forgotten Castle as always.

As I told in older posts, I will be participating in the Stem Next Fest with the last demo of The Forgotten Castle (I HOPE YOU ALL ALREADY WISHLISTED THE GAME ON STEAM). For the development of the last demo I implemented all the core mechanics of the game, so I hope that the development will be faster now. I will only have to design new zones and enemies, and create all the cutescenes. Even though things will be easier and faster now, it will take me time to complete the game development.

This week, the game also got a new art that will be used for promotional actions. I really like this one, it gives a darker approach to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/4164a5ebf06a9d13b622dc967d05b0a7518aa862.png[/img]

For the participation on the Steam Next Fest I plan to organaze a few surprises, so You will have to stay tunned to know more about it.

Remember that you can download and play the demo on Steam!

notes.title: Dev Update #8: The hook is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This week I did not have much time to work in the game, but I managed to do some things. I implemented the hook mechanic, the hook will alow to get close to enemies fast, but it will also allow to reach some zones that can't be reached with the basic dash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/807cb629beb06494902cd8bb92456f9d7ad84b21.png[/img]

I have also worked on the pixel art animation for the last power up, I will only tell you the name for the moment. It will be called DragonFire.

Stay tunned for more info, remember that soon I will publish a new enhanced demo for the Steam Demo Fest!

notes.title: Dev Update #7: New abilities under development
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As I explained last week, I am working on a special level for the demo where you will be able to try all the abilities of the game. I can show you the actual state of some of them.

The first one is cure, this will let the player recover his full health, but it will only have one use until the next checkpoint.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/02023f3bb11deea8d5adab61fb1a7c72d88cee04.gif[/img]

The second one is a crossbow. It will be anice way to attack from safety, but it will deal less damage. The crossbow will also be important for some puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/d3d15d11225abcd82c07f2c6a3ae4ca690ad336c.gif[/img]

This is everything I can show for the moment. Stay tunned for more progress soon!

notes.title: Dev Update #6: New news about the game and some cool stuff
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This week I took some decisions that you will see reflected in the game and in the game marketing very soon. Most of this decisions are related to the way that I want to market the game, but I also decided to include a new feature to the demo that I think you will like. Soon I will release a new version of the demo that will include a kind of playtest area where you will be able to try all the abilities and power ups that will be available in the final game. Right now the demo covers the first 30/60 mins of the game and there are almost no power ups in these first minutes, I would like you to experience and feel how the game will be in a more advanced part of the game. I hope you will like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/f5cfc645ac349e40fbf68801748c5539a9c771c5.png[/img]

But that is not everything I did, I have been working on some pixel art fort the game and I have also been working in new enemies and some scenes of the game that will have an important impact for the story. You can see a little spoiler in the following pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/3cc39291932012bdbd4bbf407bf7c2a3319d5999.png[/img]

Soon there will be more cool news and stuff, stay tunned!

notes.title: Dev Update #5: A few changes and new features
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This week has been kind of productive, I could work in some stuff that I had in mind and I also could solve some bugs and improve a few things.

First of all I added transition scenes between the different zones of the game. This is a cool way to load the next scene with a nice visual style instead of using a black screen with text.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/0e06edde527ec940911f12e129fb7d4b61ba6abd.png[/img]

I also changed the way that the lateral passages look. I asked on Twitter and people helped me to make it more intuitive:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/158ec612c3517ad766c429707cb29074f8b9062d.png[/img]

Finally, I have started to programm and implement new zones that I had designed but that I didn't have implemented in the game.  I have a few zones which graphic resources are already implemented that have to be programmed yet and that is what I am doing right now. Soon I will show you these new zones and enemies, but at the moment you will have to settle with this picture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/d39ec4ffbc113b055c4ba0a86153c064779a11b6.png[/img]

Stay tunned because there will be new content and news soon!

Thanx for the support!

notes.title: Dev Update #4: New font for the game and some updates!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The past two weeks I have been on a vacation from my work so I tried to relax and not work too much in the game. Even so I have worked in some things that you will find cool.

In first place I have been working in the pixel art of some enemies and bosses. I would like to have around 4 or 5 different enemies for each section of the game and that takes some work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/aa5b2fcfabc96030d39db60130a9859858ce2b9e.gif[/img]

I have also worked in a new area and it is almost finished. I just have place the lightning,  enemies and puzzles but all the graphic part is done. In the image you can see and advance of this new area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/e9f8be6659cdfa4bf5c67b590a69880e4a291c68.png[/img]

Finally, I decided to change the font in order to ve able to show well different languages, You can see the new font in this example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/ca2f36ec370388be7bd808e077929979b11e6147.png[/img]

I can't wait to show you the new areas in action with the lightning and all the enemies, I hope tat i con do it soon. Thanks for all the support and stay tunned for more progress!

notes.title: Dev Update #3: A new filter and much more!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

This week I could work on a few things. First of all I implemented a CRT filter for those players who prefer  a more retro experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/a85789aecaea4857f3fb1a93c2bd16d55870bd63.png[/img]

I also worked on the UI and the menu. The diary system of the game is now implemented and working. When things important to the story of the game happen they will be written in the diary of the main character, all from his perspective. I also deleted the afe icon with the button in the low left corner. There will be different abilities and I don't want to fill the screen with the buttons for each of the abilities, So I decided to clean the UI and give it a more sober look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/8e1235826dcc7ed9a37a72991b07a460d4c3d261.png[/img]

Another thing that I did is to rework the shadows and illumination of the game, I wasn't happy with how some lightning effects where showed in screen so I clewaned them.

Finally, I added sound for the enemies. I don't know why they didn't have any sound in first place (sometimes I leave some work for the future me and then I forget about it) but this problem is solved now and all the enemies have sounds that match their animations and movements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41788404/4e11d63c814966e303f796b00eb61022732d5d96.png[/img]

All the changes and progress that I explain here can be experienced in the third version of the demo that I released the past week.

See you soon!

notes.title: Third version of the Demo available now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I uploaded a new version of the demo. This version has the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added a retro CRT filter.
[*] The diary mechanics is now fully operative.
[*] The enemies now have sounds to make them more recognisable.
[*] HUD has been updated.
[*] Shadows have been remade.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it!
